evidence.summary: CrowdVolt provided written permission for Live Tape to perform automated browser capture of approved public event-market pages. Permission received 2026-10-15. See docs/source-access/crowdvolt-approval-2026-10-15.md.

Resident Advisor provided written permission for Live Tape to perform automated browser capture of approved public event pages for historical market-data research. Permission received 2026-10-16. See docs/source-access/resident-advisor-approval-2026-10-16.md.

DICE provided written permission for Live Tape to perform automated browser capture of approved public event-listing pages. Permission received 2026-10-17. See docs/source-access/dice-approval-2026-10-17.md.

Shotgun provided written permission for Live Tape to perform automated browser capture of approved public US event pages. Permission received 2026-10-18. See docs/source-access/shotgun-approval-2026-10-18.md.
